purpose: Per-ship reference library for monitoring interfaces and optional ship showcase studies
ownerDirections: Keep references organised for each ship.
Use the selected Rocinante diagnostic blueprint when revisiting the Rocinante look and feel.
Finish the Pella holotable and centring work before moving to other ship interfaces.
Preserve latest models, monitoring instruments, solar system and backgrounds.
Research each ship using its own production and on-screen evidence; do not reuse one Pella targeting frame as the universal design reference.
boundaries: Archival reference material only; no runtime dependency or asset-catalogue mutation.
New references do not prove implementation, native validation or release.
Owner endorsement selects design evidence, not permission to redistribute third-party artwork as app assets.
Imported existing model links retain their original provenance and are not newly verified UI evidence.
